market_question: Will the Republicans win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Incumbent Republican Susan Collins has strong cross-party appeal and has won multiple elections in blue-leaning Maine; however, she may face a serious primary challenge or retire, reducing Republican chances. Overall, I estimate a ~35% chance of a Republican victory, well above the market's 22.5%.
evidence_points: Susan Collins won re-election in 2020 with 51% despite Biden winning Maine by 9 points.
Maine has not elected a Democrat to this Senate seat since 1996; Collins has held it since 1997.
Primary risk from Trump-aligned challengers or retirement could derail Republican chances.
Ranked-choice voting may help moderates like Collins in general elections.
